verdict.rationale: Canva exposes broad API surface (Connect APIs, Apps SDK, MCP server, SCIM, CLI) covering design generation, editing via natural language, export, asset/brand management, comments, and resizing — a substantial subset of UI functionality. But there is no evidence of full UI-API parity; Connect APIs are described as integration/automation surfaces for specific workflows (bulk create, resize, comments, brand templates) rather than a complete substitute for manual design editing in the visual editor, and no OpenAPI spec was even resolvable via probe (404s), suggesting the API surface is curated rather than exhaustive. missing for 10: explicit claim/evidence of full feature parity between API and UI editor, independent confirmation that all editing operations available in the UI (e.g. granular canvas manipulation) are also API-accessible, and a working OpenAPI/swagger endpoint.
